hero_fabric_reveal.description: Cinematic white fabric/canvas reveal loop with TMN logo centered inside the white circle, animated with forward playback and continuous smooth rewind loop.
hero_fabric_reveal.implementation: Use HTML5 video canvas or SVG mask + CSS keyframe / Framer Motion scale-pulse loop simulating forward and reverse motion with TMN SVG logo embedded in the central white circle.
hero_fabric_reveal.loop_behavior: Forward playback (0s - 3s) -> Ping-pong rewind (3s - 0s) infinitely with seamless transition

background_holo_ripple.description: Full white holo-ripple / liquid canvas video loop background layer behind About, Craftsmanship, and Process sections.
background_holo_ripple.implementation: Positioned fixed/absolute behind content with mix-blend-mode or opacity mask (opacity-15 to opacity-30), triggered by scroll position using Framer Motion scroll progress.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All buttons, links, inputs, sliders, tabs, modals, and interactive items MUST include descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React marketing application with Awwwards Site-of-the-Day craftsmanship.
Strictly follow the user's explicit choices: Monochrome (black/white/grey) palette matching TMN logo.
Implement the hero fabric reveal loop video with the TMN logo sitting in the central white circle, looping forward and rewinding continuously.
Implement the second full-white holo-ripple video loop as a background for the About / Approach section with scroll-driven animations.
Ensure all contact points map strictly to WhatsApp (https://wa.me/447736325643), Phone (07736325643), and Email (info@Tmndecorating.co.uk).
Include an interactive quote/estimate calculator that generates instant estimates and offers a direct WhatsApp submission button.
Use Framer Motion for smooth entrances, staggered reveals, hover states, and chapter accordions.
Include interactive before/after image slider, lightbox gallery filters, and custom magnetic cursor.
Add 'data-testid' to every interactive button, input, slider, tab, and link.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) on sticky navbars and modals.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always specify explicit properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container text globally.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
